This looks well organized, and I can see every part we agreed on has tasks behind it — saving with automatic details, preventing duplicates, the read-later and archive workflow, search and saved searches, rich notes, bulk actions, import/export, and display preferences. Having an independent check point for each one gives me confidence.

Starting with getting a link saved, editable, and reopenable as the first milestone makes sense to me — that's the heart of it.

The task list is approved. Please go ahead and begin implementation, and show me the working app when it's ready.
